text: Excavation was not stopped by rain. Excavated 4 m3 in Trench Elm today.
Today, excavation proceeded in Trench Ash. No measured quantity was reported.
Today, excavated 5 m3 in Trench Alder. Correction: the amount excavated there today was 6 m3, replacing the earlier figure.
Today, excavated 3 m3 in Trench Pine. Tomorrow, excavation of 7 m3 is planned in Trench Oak. No excavation occurred in Trench Oak today.
